links.comparator_used: Monitoring model performance alone (labeled performance metrics) as a proxy for detecting data drift
links.outcome: Detection of data drift (natural COVID-19 emergence in chest X-rays and synthetic drift)
links.effect: No numeric effect given in the abstract; performance monitoring alone was reported as not a good proxy for detecting data drift, whereas the three drift-detection methods could detect it.
links.tradeoff: Drift detection performance depends heavily on sample size and patient features, and gaps remain for practical application of existing methods.
links.quote: We find that monitoring performance alone is not a good proxy for detecting data drift and that drift-detection heavily depends on sample size and patient features.
